MEByteSource.doc: Provides read access to the data in a media asset file.

MEDecodeFrameOptions.doc: An object that guides the video decoder operation on a per-frame basis.

MEEstimatedSampleLocation.doc: An object that provides information about the estimated sample location with the media.

MEFileInfo.doc: An object that contains file properties from the media asset.

MEFormatReaderInstantiationOptions.doc: An object that contains options to pass to a format reader extension.

MEHEVCDependencyInfo.doc: An object that provides information about the HEVC dependency attributes of a sample.

MERAWProcessingParameter.doc: An object for the RAW processor to describe each processing parameter the processor exposes.

MERAWProcessorPixelBufferManager.doc: Describes pixel buffer requirements and creates new pixel buffers.

MESampleCursorChunk.doc: An object that provides information about the chunk of media at the location of a sample.

MESampleLocation.doc: An object that provides information about the sample location with the media.

METrackInfo.doc: An object that includes track properties parsed from the media asset.

MEVideoDecoderPixelBufferManager.doc: Describes pixel buffer requirements and creates new pixel buffers.

MEFormatReader.doc: A protocol that defines the requirements for a format reader, which represents a single media asset.

MEFormatReaderExtension.doc: A protocol that defines a factory to create a new format reader with a byte source.

MERAWProcessor.doc: A protocol that defines the requirements for a RAW processor.

MERAWProcessorExtension.doc: A protocol that defines a factory to create RAW processors for a codec type that the extension implements.

MESampleCursor.doc: A protocol that defines the information to provide about samples within a track of a media asset, and enables stepping through samples in the track in decode or presentation order.

METrackReader.doc: A protocol that defines the information to provide about a track within a media asset.

MEVideoDecoder.doc: A protocol that defines the requirements for a video decoder.

MEVideoDecoderExtension.doc: A protocol that defines a factory to create new video decoders for a codec type that the extension implements.

MEDecodeFrameStatus.doc: A type that represents a non-error status related to a frame decode operation.

MEDecodeFrameFrameDropped.doc: A frame decode operation status that indicates the system dropped the output of the frame for a reason other than an error.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a new frame decode operation status with the raw value that you specify.

MEFileInfoFragmentsStatus.doc: An enumeration that describes if a media asset contains or supports fragments.

MEFormatReaderParseAdditionalFragmentsSt.doc: Informational status flags that the format reader returns after parsing additional fragments.
Indicates that the format reader received one or more fragments.
Indicates that the format reader can’t receive any more fragments.
Indicates that the format reader file size increased.

init(rawValue:).doc: Create a new information status flag for parsing additional fragments.

-availableLengthAtOffset:.doc: Gets the number of available bytes from the offset within the byte source.

-byteSourceForRelatedFileName:error:.doc: Creates a new byte source for a related file.

-readDataOfLength:fromOffset:completionH.doc: Reads bytes from a byte source into a data object.

-readDataOfLength:fromOffset:toDestinati.doc: Reads bytes from a byte source into a buffer.
Reads bytes from a byte source into a buffer.

-initWithByteSource:estimatedSampleLocat.doc: Creates an estimated sample location object with the byte source, sample location, and data location that you specify.

-createPixelBufferAndReturnError:.doc: Generates a pixel buffer using the session’s pixel buffer pool.

-initWithByteSource:chunkStorageRange:ch.doc: Creates a new sample cursor chunk with byte source and chunk data that you provide.

-initWithByteSource:sampleLocation:.doc: Creates a sample location object with the byte source and sample location that you specify.

-initWithMediaType:trackID:formatDescrip.doc: Creates a new track info object with the media type, track ID, and format descriptions that you specify.

-createPixelBufferAndReturnError:.doc: Generates a pixel buffer using the session’s pixel buffer pool.

contentType.doc: The format of the byte source file.

fileLength.doc: The length of the byte source file.

fileName.doc: The name of the file for the byte source.

relatedFileNamesInSameDirectory.doc: An array of related file names in the parent directory of the byte source file.

doNotOutputFrame.doc: A Boolean value that hints to the decoder whether or not it should emit an image buffer for the frame.

realTimePlayback.doc: A Boolean value that hints to the decoder to use a low-power mode that can’t decode faster than 1x real-time.

byteSource.doc: The byte source to use to read the data for the sample.

estimatedSampleLocation.doc: The estimated starting file offset and size in bytes of the sample.

refinementDataLocation.doc: The starting file offset and size in bytes of the data necessary to provide an accurate sample location.

MEFileInfoFragmentsStatus.doc: An enumeration that describes if a media asset contains or supports fragments.

duration.doc: The duration of the media asset, if available.

fragmentsStatus.doc: Indicates if the media asset contains fragments or is extendable by fragments.

allowIncrementalFragmentParsing.doc: Enables support for parsing additional fragments.

constraintIndicatorFlags.doc: The HEVC constraint indicator flags (6 bytes), if available.

levelIndex.doc: The HEVC level index, if available.

profileCompatibilityFlags.doc: The HEVC profile compatibility flags (4 bytes), if available.

profileIndex.doc: The HEVC profile index, if available.

profileSpace.doc: The HEVC profile space, if available.

stepwiseTemporalSubLayerAccess.doc: A Boolean value that indicates if the sample has an HEVC stepwise temporal sublayer access (STSA) picture.

syncSampleNALUnitType.doc: The NAL unit type for HEVC sync sample groups.

temporalLevel.doc: The HEVC temporal level, if available.

temporalSubLayerAccess.doc: A Boolean value that indicates if the sample has an HEVC temporal sublayer access (TSA) picture.

tierFlag.doc: The HEVC tier level flag, if available.

MERAWProcessingBooleanParameter.doc: An object that describes a Boolean parameter of a RAW processor.

MERAWProcessingFloatParameter.doc: An object that describes a floating-point parameter of a RAW processor.

MERAWProcessingIntegerParameter.doc: An object that describes an integer parameter of a RAW processor.

MERAWProcessingListElementParameter.doc: An object that describes a list element parameter of a RAW processor.

MERAWProcessingListParameter.doc: An object that describes a list parameter of a RAW processor.

MERAWProcessingSubGroupParameter.doc: An object that describes a sub group parameter of a RAW processor.

enabled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the extension enables the parameter.

key.doc: A unique key string identifying the parameter.

longDescription.doc: A localized description of the parameter, suitable for displaying in a tool tip or similar explanatory UI.

name.doc: A localized human-readable name for the parameter, suitable for displaying in application UI.

pixelBufferAttributes.doc: A dictionary that contains the attributes Video Toolbox uses to create a pixel buffer for the video RAW processor.

byteSource.doc: The byte source to use to read the data for the sample.

chunkInfo.doc: An object that provides details about the chunk in the media.

chunkStorageRange.doc: The offset location and length of the sample’s chunk within the byte source.

sampleIndexWithinChunk.doc: The offset index of the sample within the chunk, in samples.

byteSource.doc: The byte source to use to read the data for the sample.

sampleLocation.doc: The starting file offset and size in bytes of the sample.

enabled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the track is enabled by default.

extendedLanguageTag.doc: A string that indicates the language tag associated with the track, as an IETF BCP 47 (RFC 4646) language identifier.

formatDescriptions.doc: An array of format descriptions for the track.

mediaType.doc: The media type of the track.

naturalSize.doc: Indicates the natural dimensions of the media data referenced by the track.

naturalTimescale.doc: The natural timescale of the track.

nominalFrameRate.doc: The frame rate of the track in frames per second, as a 32-bit floating point number.

preferredTransform.doc: Indicates the preferred affine display transform of the track media for visual display.

requiresFrameReordering.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether frame reordering occurs in the track.

trackEdits.doc: An array of edit segments for the given track.

trackID.doc: An integer that identifies the track within the media asset.

pixelBufferAttributes.doc: A dictionary that contains the attributes Video Toolbox uses to create a pixel buffer for the decoder.
